# Queue

Implements queueing for messages not yet sendt

* Takes in new messages from source
* Enques the message to the queue flow variable
* Triggers the send message node to send the top element
* If the post is succesfull:
    * The message is dequeued
    * Appended to master_log
* else
    * The retry is triggered
    * The message attemts to send again
    * If message fails more then limit.
    * attempts stop and routs message out


## Note

* As it uses a flow variable it will only work if inside a Flow (not another subflow)
